The vendored copy is `lpaq9m.zpaq`, a binary archive containing no source
and no licence notice, and `SOURCES` records only a zip URL this vault does
not mirror. The licence is recorded on the maintainer's statement of
15 November 2026 that LPAQ carries the same licence as paq8, which
`SOURCES` records as GPL-2.0.

This file is a record of where the claim comes from, not the licence text.
The text is `LICENSES/GPL-2.0-only.txt`, and it applies if the statement is
right. If the upstream archive is ever fetched and its readme read, replace
this file with what it says.
